mapper.insert: insert into chat_sessions (project_id, user_account_id, leader_account_id, status) values (#{projectId}, #{ownerAccountId}, #{leaderAccountId}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: select id, project_id, user_account_id, leader_account_id, status, disabled_at, created_at from chat_sessions where project_id = #{projectId} limit 1
mapper.update: update chat_sessions set status = 'ACTIVE', disabled_at = null where project_id = #{projectId} and status = 'DISABLED'
update chat_sessions set status = 'DISABLED', disabled_at = coalesce(disabled_at, current_timestamp) where project_id = #{projectId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
update chat_sessions set status = 'DISABLED', disabled_at = coalesce(disabled_at, current_timestamp) where id = #{id} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select cs.id, cs.project_id, cs.user_account_id, cs.leader_account_id, cs.status, cs.disabled_at, cs.created_at, p.title as project_title, latest_message.content as latest_message, latest_message.sent_at as latest_message_at, latest_message.sender_account_id as latest_message_sender_account_id, current_member.member_role as current_user_role, ( select count(*) from chat_group_members member_count where member_count.group_id = cs.id and member_count.member_status = 'JOINED' ) as member_count from chat_sessions cs inner join projects p on p.id = cs.project_id inner join chat_group_members current_member on current_member.group_id = cs.id and current_member.account_id = #{accountId} and current_member.member_status = 'JOINED' left join chat_messages latest_message on latest_message.id = ( select cm.id from chat_messages cm where cm.session_id = cs.id order by cm.sent_at desc, cm.id desc limit 1 ) where cs.status = 'ACTIVE' order by coalesce(latest_message.sent_at, cs.created_at) desc

select case when p.owner_account_id = #{accountId} then 'PUBLISHER' when p.leader_account_id = #{accountId} then 'LEADER' when pm.id is not null then 'PARTICIPANT' else null end from chat_sessions cs inner join projects p on p.id = cs.project_id left join project_members pm on pm.project_id = p.id and pm.account_id = #{accountId} and pm.join_status in ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') where cs.id = #{sessionId} and ( p.owner_account_id = #{accountId} or p.leader_account_id = #{accountId} or pm.id is not null ) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into chat_group_members (group_id, account_id, member_role, member_status) values (#{sessionId}, #{accountId}, #{memberRole}, 'JOINED') on duplicate key update member_role = case when chat_group_members.member_role = 'PUBLISHER' or values(member_role) = 'PUBLISHER' then 'PUBLISHER' when chat_group_members.member_role = 'LEADER' or values(member_role) = 'LEADER' then 'LEADER' else 'PARTICIPANT' end, member_status = 'JOINED', joined_at = current_timestamp

insert into chat_group_members (group_id, account_id, member_role, member_status) select #{sessionId}, pm.account_id, 'PARTICIPANT', 'JOINED' from project_members pm where pm.project_id = #{projectId} and pm.join_status in ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') on duplicate key update member_role = chat_group_members.member_role
mapper.select: select a.id as account_id, a.username, a.avatar_url, gm.member_role, coalesce(pm.represented_count, 0) as represented_count from chat_sessions cs inner join projects p on p.id = cs.project_id inner join chat_group_members gm on gm.group_id = cs.id and gm.member_status = 'JOINED' inner join accounts a on a.id = gm.account_id left join project_members pm on pm.project_id = p.id and pm.account_id = a.id and pm.join_status in ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') where cs.id = #{sessionId} order by case gm.member_role when 'PUBLISHER' then 0 when 'LEADER' then 1 else 2 end, gm.joined_at asc, a.id asc
